packageRules.description: Hold the changelog preset on 9.x. Release runs through cycjimmy/semantic-release-action, whose semantic-release@25 pulls @semantic-release/release-notes-generator@14 -> conventional-changelog-writer@8. Preset 10 plants a deliberate tripwire in writerOpts.mainTemplate that makes a handlebars writer (<=8) throw "Missing helper", so a 10.x bump breaks the release with no test failure to warn us. Lift this once release-notes-generator ships conventional-changelog-writer@9+.
